title: “Mall world”? Maybe? Probably not: Thinking out loud.
content: I still want to post, even if I don’t think I’ve been to “Mall world”. I discovered this phenomenon a day ago through a video of someone looking into it. I’ve definitely had dreams in settings similar to all the places people say they’ve been in this lucid dream place (I would also like to say I don’t think I’ve ever had any “gate program” experiences, I do remember sound/ signal hearing and sight tests during health physicals but that’s not nearly the same thing). I’ve never had a dream about awful dirty toilets ( but I have dreamt of weird crazy luxury bathrooms; for example, bathrooms with glass walls people can see into, and singing toilets when they flush), I’ve also never dreamt of a Tsunami on a beach, though I have dreamt of being on a beach, it’s usually the only one I’ve ever been to though, I live 45 minutes from a local beach and that’s the one that shows up in my dreams (none recently). However, I HAVE had dreams of a crazy place that resembled an Airport Lobby/ check in/ baggage claim area. I’ve had one particular dream where I was running from a Zombie that resembled my mother and she chased me until I suddenly realized I was in my old highschool hallways which seemed to go on forever. Eventually I found myself at the top of a steep escalator in, yes, a mall. I don’t remember if it was infinite, but I do remember it was bright with natural light from a skylight and there were stores on either side of me in the wide area. I can’t say whether they were connected in the way everyone claims, I’ve never dreamed of an interconnected place that I could derive a map as detailed and as absolute as what some people have drawn. I honestly just think I’m drawing from an amalgamation of similar common dreams everyone has had before including me, but I do somewhat relate to having “back room” type dreams. Liminal space freaks me out, so I’ve had several dreams throughout my life that are similar to all of these that people say (which is why it fascinates me so much). Another dream I’ve had that I’ve heard many people have related to is the infinite mansion dream, which I’ve had probably more than being in a Mall type place. In this dream it starts with me in a large mansion room, like an empty ballroom (maybe, I don’t know, it’s never a distinct room), that has a tiled black and white checkered floor. In one dream (and I was pretty young, around 13 or 14), I dreamt I was in this room and surrounded by dead rotting geese and it unsettled me so much I ran into a dark creepy hallway to escape it, and it was a long LONG hallway with infinite rooms. None of which I walked into before I woke up. I apologize for the long post, but I was curious as to people’s thoughts. I also want to know if it’s possible for someone who was not tested for a gifted program or have seen any aliens or alien like objects to their knowledge to have dreams like this, because I thought it was pretty universally normal until I saw the stuff about the multiple people that can draw actual maps of a place like that. Anyway. Happy New Year. 👍🏻🙂
